verdict.rationale: Teller documents a quickstart that ends with linking your first financial accounts, plus a sandbox environment with simulated data and documented test MFA codes. A first-party React hook for Teller Connect also exists. However, auth uses Teller-issued mTLS client certificates rather than simple API keys, and nothing shows the signup-to-credentials step is self-serve or fast. Missing for 10: explicit self-serve signup and credential issuance, server-side client libraries beyond the React Connect component, evidence that the quickstart is runnable end to end, independent hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-link.
